# Wevie

> Wevie is a SaaS white-label fleet management platform for shared mobility and vehicle rental operators. It provides a fully customizable app (iOS/Android), an operational dashboard, booking and payment systems, geofencing, compliance tools, and AI-powered fleet optimization. Powering 25+ million rentals, 15,000+ connected vehicles, and 4+ million users across 100+ venues and cities.

Wevie is built by Dee Jungle / Mirai S.r.l., based in Bussolengo, Verona, Italy. The platform is available in English, Italian, French, German, and Spanish. 
Wevie is the technology provider behind [Bit Mobility](https://bitmobility.it), one of the leading shared mobility operators in Italy and Europe.

Key facts:

- White-label mobile app (iOS & Android) with custom UI, light/dark themes, and branded onboarding
- Real-time fleet tracking, remote diagnostics, remote vehicle control, and geofencing
- AI-based repositioning suggestions to optimize vehicle distribution and reduce operational costs
- Dynamic pricing models based on area, time, and vehicle type
- Automatic payment handling and debt recovery (Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Satispay, Nexi)
- API integrations: MDS, GBFS, MaaS, Google Maps, Zendesk, Power BI
- Multi-tenant architecture with tenant-specific configuration
- Compliance: MDS v2.0, GBFS v2.3, Google GBFS support
- AI/ML features: face recognition, OCR document verification, helmet detection, wrong-way detection, sidewalk riding detection
- Insurance integration (per-trip and per-subscription)
- Marketing CRM: push/SMS/in-app campaigns, contests, gamification, referral programs, vouchers
- Wallet system with dual-value (real + bonus), auto-recharge, and bounty

## Use cases

- [Urban Micro-mobility](https://wevie.com/#use-cases): Real-time tracking, remote diagnostics, geofencing, and intelligent repositioning for scooters, bikes, and e-scooters in urban settings
- [Corporate Fleet Management](https://wevie.com/#use-cases): Remote monitoring and management of company vehicle fleets with geolocation, diagnostics, user administration, and ESG reporting
- [Hospitality & Tourism](https://wevie.com/#use-cases): Revenue sharing, QR access, request workflows for hotels, resorts, campgrounds, and tourist destinations
- [B2B Fleet Services](https://wevie.com/#use-cases): Multi-venue fleet operations serving hotels, corporate campuses, and managed communities
